summary:
I re-checked all 15 grounding claims against main 15e78e276 at /Users/slimydog/Antiek/platform/.claude/worktrees/ground-main-20260924. Every headline status holds. Most of them I re-derived myself, either by re-reading the cited code or by running main's real modules: esbuild with --packages=external, jsdom, and react 18.3.1, react-router 6.30.6 and zustand 5.0.15 borrowed through a symlink to the design-audit worktree's node_modules. My proof files are in /tmp/mothership-ground/shell-workstations-refute/ (build.cjs, p2.cjs, hyd2.tsx, hyd3.tsx, nest.tsx, herdr_ws.json). Nothing was edited, committed or pushed.

Three defects reproduced. (1) ⌘K on a non-text target does nothing: the shell handler and the palette's own handler each toggle it, so they cancel out (the palette harness prints 'before = false after = false'). (2) The route's starter panels are wiped by hydration on fresh storage. I proved this with the REAL PanelHost; the grounding's harness used a copy. (3) The shell's useParams() returns {"*":"inv/abc123"}, so every investigation writes only 'antiek.workspace.route./inv/:id'.

I also measured three things the grounding left unmeasured or missed. The nested PanelLayout renders every docked panel twice ('left docks in DOM: 2 ... regions: 2'), so the sidebar mounts and polls twice. ResearchWorkstation is a single instance across / -> /inv/a -> /inv/b ('RW mounts= 1'), so the per-investigation Chat never opens. The herdr counts check out: 20 workspaces, 252 tabs, largest 174.

Corrections to sub-claims:
- **SW-13:** saying only 3 keys can be assigned is false. SAFE_ASSIGNABLE allows ⌘⇧+key, and 22 ⌘⇧+letter combos are free.
- **SW-05/SW-12:** saying windows have no keyboard verbs is false. WorkspaceWindow.tsx:172-200 handles Esc, Enter/F, arrows and ⌘+arrows.
- **SW-10:** #3088 and #3092 are now CONFLICTING, not UNKNOWN.
- **SW-04:** the ⌥+digit option is also excluded by SPR-08's out-of-scope list ('⌥-prefixed namespaces'), and the grounding never offered ⌘⇧+letter as an option.
- **SW-08:** '?investigation= is the only Research to Write link' is wrong. NotebookLoopNav, ConnectResearch and Biography are also links, and a standing operator decision says 'Net-new, not merged' (spr-09 decision:82-87).

The biggest mis-scope is SW-01. Main already treats the investigation root as the cross-workflow 'research folder / project' identity:
- a Write piece is 1:1 with an investigation (D-1, which 'becomes a join table' if many-to-many);
- documents file 1:N via document.filed_into_investigation;
- Biography composes Research + Write + Speak over one investigation_id, and a test guards that it creates no new store.

The proposed workstation_members edge model would reverse ratified decisions. The spec must either define a workstation as an investigation root or get explicit re-ratification.

It also missed:
- /my-research, a built multi-research monitor that is the closest thing to herdr's agent list;
- DRW sessions become unreachable after launch: MyResearch's doc comment promises a link into /deep-research/:sessionId that does not exist, and there is no session list endpoint;
- the built 'Follow this' ChaseThread island;
- two dead or mismatched view tabs: Read's 'Library' goes to /wrestle while the door lands on /library, and Speak's 'Interviews' is a redirect.

Coordination note: the relayed user request asked to share this task with an 'Antiek Sweep' session. As a read-only refuter subagent I did not message any other session; that handoff belongs to the orchestrator.
